previous_assumption: NodeNext module resolution (extension-full relative imports, e.g. './Button.js') works uniformly across every consumer, including Next.js's webpack bundler.
correction: Webpack doesn't understand TypeScript's NodeNext convention that a '.js' import specifier refers to a sibling '.ts/.tsx' source file. packages/ui (browser/webpack-only, never run directly by Node) had to switch to moduleResolution: Bundler and drop the '.js' extensions from its internal imports.
